title: Senate approves delegated legislative powers for Fujimori government on security and El Niño
detail: The Senate approved, 35 votes to 18 with 6 abstentions, a substitute text delegating legislative powers to the Fujimori government on citizen security and El Niño response. The Constitution Committee text widened the Chamber of Deputies' version from 20 to 27 powers; the Executive had originally asked for 66 areas over 120 days. Outlets differ on duration (90 vs 60 days). Critics, including deputy Mirtha Vásquez and Juntos por el Perú, said the Senate reinstated measures Deputies had rejected and may have breached procedure, a possible Constitutional Tribunal challenge. The date is inferred from a 21 Oct report saying the vote was 'this Wednesday'.

media.caption: Peru's Senate delegates legislative powers to the Fujimori government
